essence: One should chant as many times after the oblation as the number of offerings made.
By following the previous procedure, one obtains a hundred gold coins within a month.
Starting from the new-moon month and following months, one obtains variegated garments.
One obtains things accompanied by pleasing and fortune-endowed things.
By that practice, prosperity in rice will arise within six months without doubt.
